♊ The Gemini Cloth. OFFENSE

Signature Technique

@UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Another Dimension]

Cloth Passive — Two Faces

You are trained in Deception. You maintain two complete identities — Light and Shadow — that cannot be linked to one another by anything short of true seeing. You may swap between them as a free action once per hour.

In Shadow, your Signature Technique becomes @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Genro Mao Ken (Shadow)] instead.

Ascendant Boon — Galaxian Explosion [OFFENSE]

Once per round you may cast your Signature Technique without spending a Focus Point.

You gain @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Galaxian Explosion].

Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Sky: Ascendant (Gemini)]

Zenith Boon — Galaxian Explosion (Zenith) [OFFENSE]

As the Ascendant Boon. In addition, a duplicate of you appears in an adjacent space at the start of each of your turns. It uses your statistics, acts on your initiative with 2 actions and can only Strike and Stride — no Techniques, no Focus Points, no skill actions — and vanishes at the start of your next turn. Only one duplicate can exist at a time.

Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Sky: Zenith (Gemini)]

11th-Level Cloth Ability — Genro Mao Ken

@UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Genro Mao Ken]
